summary: Six shots, about 21 seconds: one quiet act of kindness at closing time. Please sign off the direction before we spend on the animatic.

notes.text: The hook leans on 'closing time' — shot 01 now shows the chairs already upturned so it reads without a word.
The turn is a single insert: his hand lifting the umbrella. Is 2.5s enough for it to land?
The yellow umbrella is the only saturated colour in the piece, planted in the stand in 03 and fired in 04.
